key_idea: If all pairs have the same sum vector, the lexicographically smallest player must be paired with the lexicographically largest, and so on inward.
sketch: If n is odd the answer is impossible. Sort the players by (b,p) and check that v[i]+v[n-1-i] equals v[0]+v[n-1] in both coordinates for all i. Correctness: the partner of the smallest element is target minus it, which is the largest element of the multiset; remove both and repeat. O(n log n). Pitfalls: odd n, and duplicates (handled naturally by sorting).
